thread.title: Top 10 Stock Market Predictions for 2019

author: Matt McCall
title: Top 10 Stock Market Predictions for 2019
text:
Home > Stock Picks > Stock Market Today > Top 10 Stock Market Predictions for 2019 Dec 28, 2018, 8:00 am EST December 27, 2018 Top 10 Stock Market Predictions for 2019 The likelihood of some of these stock market predictions coming true in 2019 is fairly high http://bit.ly/2Ajxt1e
It’s at this time of year that I like to look ahead to the coming 12 months and make some stock market predictions.
How will the next 12 months play out? What major catalysts will occur? Where will the market be one year from today?
Some of those questions are harder to answer than others. But we can make educated guesses, and those are what I’d like to share with you today.
I have come up with 10 stock market predictions as we close the book on 2018 and look ahead to the New Year. They range from highly likely — such as the Federal Reserve raising interest rates — to a snowball’s chance in you know where — like the United States legalizing marijuana on a federal basis.
Nevertheless, each always has an education theory behind it. And oftentimes it is the most far-fetched stock market predictions that end up coming to fruition.
Let’s dive in… Source: MayApps207 via WikiMedia
Teledoc (NYSE: TDOC ), the leader in telehealth — one of my favorite mega-trends for the coming years — offers patients the ability to see a doctor from the comfort of their own homes. All they need is an internet-connected device. That convenience combined with money and time saved is a win-win for all parties involved.
Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ) is making a push into healthcare, and what better way to be at the forefront of future? If it does not by TDOC, I suspect a large health insurer will swoop in with an offer. Stock Market Predictions: Amazon Will Buy a Big Box Retailer Source: Shutterstock
Speaking of Amazon, the tech giant made a shocking move in 2018 when it brought Whole Foods Market to get into the grocery business and establish a brick-and-mortar presence. The move has been successful, and I expect AMZN’s next move in retail dominance will result in another purchase.
By securing more real estate, the company can open more hubs and locations where customers can interact with the whole Amazon experience. A few possible options include Target (NYSE: TGT ), Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ: COST ) and the remaining Sears Holdings (OTCMKTS: SHLDQ ). Source: Yuanbin Du Via Flickr
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is sitting on approximately $237 billion in cash. That’s nearly as much as the entire market cap of retail giant Walmart (NYSE: WMT ). I look for the company to start spending that money as it prepares for its next big hit.
Behind the scenes, AAPL has been preparing to become a leader in healthcare and wearables. The future of healthcare will be focused on tracking daily health vitals, and the Apple Watch will be the core of that. But to get there, the company will need to make some acquisitions — possibly worth tens of billions of dollars. Stock Market Predictions: Uber and Lyft Will Go Public … And End Up Disappointing Source: Shutterstock
The two leading rideshare companies will make their 2019 market debuts to fanfare. Individual investors will chase these stocks and buy at highs, but look for falls to new lows not long after.
I see a Facebook (NASDAQ: FB ) kind of IPO for both of these companies — they’ll disappoint in the first year before starting uptrends in 2020. Stock Market Predictions: The S&P 500 Will Climb a Minimum of 25% Source: Shutterstock
At some point in 2019, I look for the S&P 500 to be up at least 25% from the 2018 close. The combination of fading trade issues with China, solid corporate earnings, a slowdown in negative political rhetoric and low valuations will drive investors back to stocks.
But keep in mind the key phrase here. I am not saying the S&P will close 25% in the green. Just that at some point it will show those kinds of gains. Stock Market Predictions: Fake Meat Will Be Good News Source: Shutterstock
Meat alternative company Beyond Meat has filed to go public. Also be on the lookout for synthetic diamonds to take over the diamond industry. Both are exactly what millennials are looking for as they upend two traditional industries.
And I have to say … I am a fan of them! Stock Market Predictions: A Large Country Will Be Hit With a Major Cyberattack Source: Shutterstock
I am not going to say which country, but I expect this to make a big impact. All related stocks, especially cybersecurity ones, will benefit for months. Stock Market Predictions: Cryptocurrencies Will Bounce Back Source: Shutterstock
2018 was a very difficult year for crypto stocks and coins.
There appears to be a negative stigma here, but I look for 2019 to be stronger with the rally led by the largest coins. Stock Market Predictions: Microsoft (MSFT) Will Join the $1 Trillion Club Source: Shutterstock
Software giant Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT ) still has some ways to go — it’s currently valued under $800 billion — but I expect it to join the likes of AMZN and AAPL relatively soon. Once it does, look for it remain the largest company in the world for most of the year. Stock Market Predictions : Oat Milk Will Become the New Almond Milk Source: Shutterstock
And for those that don’t remember, almond milk was the new soy milk over the last few years. I always like to throw one fun prediction into my list!
Give oat milk a try in your latte and I know you’ll be hooked. This is a craze we can even capitalize on, and I’m keep an eye out for potential investments.
Well there you have it … my top 10 predictions for 2019!
With so many innovative trends already at work and new ones popping up every day, 2019 is shaping up to be an exciting year.
For now, I wish you and your family a safe and happy holiday season. Here’s to a prosperous New Year!
